text:
tess: Quick sync — Lynxbridge private deploy post-cutover. Putting a pin in network/KMS/IAM items and a renewal-risk note. TL;DR: most things green, one audit-log gap + KMS rotation timing unclear.
tess: attaching brief notes from the handoff call earlier — will capture action owners here.
evansupport: Thanks for the runthrough, team. We saw one 503 during the DNS switchover but apps recovered. Noticed some missing CloudTrail entries for the bastion.
harry: @evan can you paste the approximate time for the 503 and the missing CT events? helps me correlate with firewall flaps.
evansupport: 503 around 2026-03-18T14:22Z. CloudTrail gaps roughly 14:20-14:30Z.
harry: got it. I see a transient ACL change from the carrier at 14:21Z in our packet logs. Looks like a route re-advert that dropped the path for ~30s. I'll add a mitigation note to the runbook.
priya: FYI on audit logs: customer requested 90-day retention but their SIEM expects 365. Current plan was 90. If they plan to renew at EoY we should surface the extra storage cost.
tess: good catch. @priya can you estimate incremental cost if we bump to 365? put a quick calc in the thread.
priya: ballpark: ~+12% to logging bill for the account given current ingestion rates. I'll give a precise number by EOD.
harry: on KMS: customer encrypted keys in our managed KMS wrap but asked about rotation cadence. Current default rotation is 365d. They requested 90d for compliance. Switching to 90d requires key schedule change and a short maintenance window for re-wrapping artifacts.
evansupport: compliance team pushing 90d for now. Can we do rotation with zero-downtime?
priya: zero-downtime is tricky for large volumes. We can do online key-rotation with dual-write wrapping: new keys for writes and background rewrap for objects, but that will spike CPU/IO. Need a planned window or throttling.
harry: propose this action plan: 1) enable 90d rotation with dual-wrap for new writes 2) schedule background rewrap over 7 days at low traffic windows 3) add circuit-breaker if CPU > 70%. Anyone object?
etcsys: infra-bot: scheduled job created: `kms-rewrap-lynxbridge` starting 2026-03-22T02:00Z, window 7 days. Owner: harry.
tess: thanks infra-bot. @harry please add rollback steps in runbook.
harry: will do — will add commands and `--throttle` example: `./rewrap --src-key k-01 --dest-key k-02 --max-qps 50`
priya: audit-log gap: I'll open an ops ticket with our ingestion team to backfill via S3 copies if CT API has the missing shard. If not available, we'll mark as incomplete and note in the postmortem.
tess: renewal risk: Customer indicated concern about growing logging costs + rotation ops. We should offer a short-term discount for extended retention if they commit to Dedicated by next quarter. Anyone from AM/sales to chime in?
evansupport: appreciate that. I'll flag to my procurement contact — they'd prefer a 6mo trial for 365 retention.
priya: I'll prepare two cost scenarios (90d vs 365d) and an ops-impact note for rotation.
harry: I'll update the runbook/network playbook with the carrier flap mitigation and the `rewrap` steps.
tess: OK — action owners: priya (cost + backfill check), harry (runbook + rewrap orchestration), tess (commercial ask to AM). Follow-up sync Friday 14:00 PT.
evansupport: sounds good. thanks team :thumbsup:
priya: noted, will post numbers by EOD.
harry: ping me if you need any logs — I uploaded packet captures to the shared folder: https://redwood.example/lynxbridge/pcaps/14mar
tess: closing here, will open formal postmortem doc with these action items and link. Appreciate the quick cross-team response.
